title: MCP servers config
description: Map of MCP server name to the entry the executor adapter writes into the run worktree's project-level .mcp.json. A task opts in by listing server names under its `mcp` field; a name with no entry here is a validation error.

type.description: Only local (spawned-by-the-CLI) servers for now; a remote entry needs a credential story first

tools.description: MCP tool allowlist for this server as the CLI understands it; ["*"] enables everything the server exposes
